sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 500. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Status ailment resistance value boosted by 60 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies dual attack, reducing the cooldown time of the next Ability used to 0 (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Overcast for 60 seconds ([Special] increases max HP by 100%; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; increases all elemental defense by 60; recovers 50 Cost. After the effect ends, Time Extend activates and extends the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to yourself by 60 seconds for one time only.).
-Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).

-During Element Battles when this Unison effect is used, the value of the Fire element weakening effect on monsters is increased by 10%.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 700. Success value 100. 3x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Scorching for 40 seconds with a success value of 130.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frozen for 40 seconds with a success value of 130.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Rejection for 40 seconds with a success value of 130.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Insanity for 40 seconds with a success value of 130.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 100 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 60000
Confuse and Prohibit Unison Resistance Up by 70

[Frostblade Fatewoven] Jotun or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
